sections.headline: Palace tells Filipinos to upskill as ‘AI era’ sets in
sections.body: [DRY RUN, no Claude call] *Inquirer*: [Palace tells Filipinos to upskill as ‘AI era’ sets in](https://newsinfo.inquirer.net/2337215/palace-tells-filipinos-to-upskill-as-ai-era-sets-in). MANILA, Philippines — Malacañang on Friday urged Filipino workers to acquire artificial intelligence (AI)-related skills to keep pace with changing labor market demands as the country navigates the “AI era.” Palace Press Officer Claire Castro said that while AI may lead to job losses in some sectors, it could also create new employment opportunities, including higher-paying jobs.
